newsitem.title: USA: Duckwall-ALCO Stores to add 25 stores.
newsitem.headline: Duckwall-ALCO Stores to add 25 stores.

text.p: Retailer Duckwall-ALCO Stores Inc, which operates 200 stores, said Monday it will add 25 new stores between now and the end of its fiscal year that ends February 1, 1998.
Since 1990, Duckwall-ALCO has doubled its number of retail locations and increased geographic coverage by more than 80 percent. It now operates 140 ALCO stores and 60 Duckwall stores in 18 states.

Duckwall variety stores usually are located in smaller communities and are intended to act as the primary convenience retailer for the community. ALCO discount stores are full-line discount stores and usually are located in communities where no major discount chains are present.
